description: blocknoteUtils: a link whose href is javascript:alert(1) emits no anchor and preserves the link text, in all four emission paths (BlockNote HTML, ProseMirror HTML, BlockNote Markdown, ProseMirror Markdown).
blocknoteUtils: hrefs using data:, vbscript: and file: schemes, a protocol-relative //host URL, and evasions by leading whitespace, embedded tab/newline and mixed case are all rejected.
blocknoteUtils: http, https and mailto hrefs survive unchanged and keep target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"; relative paths and fragments are preserved.
blocknoteUtils: a code block containing <script>alert(1)</script> is HTML-escaped in convertBlockNoteToHTML output. This test fails against the current no-op escape at :754.
blocknoteUtils: an unknown block type carrying string content is escaped, and a code block's language prop containing a quote-and-angle-bracket payload cannot break out of the class attribute.
blocknoteUtils: textColor, backgroundColor and textAlignment props carrying an attribute-breakout payload cannot escape the style attribute at block and inline level.
blocknoteUtils: existing conversion behaviour for paragraphs, headings, lists, marks, mentions, images and tables is unchanged by the hardening, guarding the shared ticket and document consumers.
DB integration: a quote saved with rich terms persists terms_and_conditions_block as jsonb and terms_and_conditions as its flattened plain-text projection, and reloading returns both.
DB integration: a quote whose terms_and_conditions_block is null still reads and renders its plain-text terms, confirming the backward-compatible path against migrated schema.
DB integration: rich terms survive create-from-template, duplicate, save-as-template and create-revision, with both columns arriving together on the new row.
DB integration: a plain-string write through the REST API create/update schema sets the text column and clears a previously-populated block column.
AST schema: a richText node parses against the zod nodeSchema, and a richText node carrying an unknown property is rejected by the strict schema.
react-renderer: a richText node bound to BlockNote content emits the converter's HTML with a live anchor, and a richText node bound to a javascript: link emits no anchor.
react-renderer: a richText node resolving to a plain string renders it escaped with whiteSpace 'pre-line', and resolving to null renders nothing rather than a placeholder.
react-renderer: an existing layout using the text node renders identically to its pre-change output, including the sibling card's pre-line treatment.
Quote PDF: generating a PDF for a quote with rich terms produces HTML containing a resolved anchor to the external terms URL; generating one for a plain-text quote reproduces the pre-change output.

Migration: the terms-copy rewrite converts stock text nodes to richText in both the standard rows and tenant-owned rows, leaves a tenant-customized terms-copy node untouched, is idempotent on a second run, and reverses cleanly.
workspaceAst: a richText node round-trips through designer import and export without losing its content binding, and an AST node of an unrecognized type raises on import rather than being dropped.
QuoteForm: the Terms & Conditions editor seeds from block content when present and from a paragraph built from the text column when the block column is null, and submitting sends both values.
QuoteForm: the editor renders for a business template and the template-selection prefill carries block content into a new quote.

QuoteDetail and the client portal QuoteDetailPage render the same converted HTML for one rich value, and preserve their existing empty-state behaviour (em-dash on the MSP detail, section hidden on the portal).
